verdict.rationale: PlayCanvas ships several official, npm-published SDKs. These include the MIT `playcanvas` engine package (v2.22.2, about 48k weekly downloads per a runtime probe), `@playcanvas/react`, `@playcanvas/web-components`, `@playcanvas/pcui` and the `@playcanvas/splat-transform` library. It also documents a scriptable Editor API and offers `create-playcanvas` to scaffold TypeScript projects that include AI-agent Skills. Missing for 10: no official OpenAPI spec or typed client SDK for the REST API (OpenAPI probe returned 404), and no independent hands-on report of the current SDK developer experience.
